names.es: Huevo Frito Consciente del Lugar (temperatura real del aceite)

metadata.notes: Built 2026-08-16, the FRY/oil sibling of two-eggs-shared-pot.json — the same FILL/HEAT_PLACE/PLACE_IN mechanism, generalized the same day from water-only (isBoilingMedium/isDeepVessel) to any isPourable medium in an isVessel tool (see fill.json's scopeNote, oil.json's isPourableNote). oilTempC: '175' on the FRY step is no longer just an unenforced informational parameter here: params.placeId makes recipe-runner.ts's assertPlaceReady require pan-1 to ACTUALLY be at or above fry.json's own declared oilTempC minimum (120°C) before FRY is allowed to run at all — reusing huevo-frito.json's exact real durationSeconds/yolkDoneness/edgeStyle values (90s, runny, puntilla) so this is a genuine place-aware variant of a real existing dish, not a synthetic mechanism demo.
metadata.scopeNote: Deliberately omits SALT (unlike huevo-frito.json) — kept minimal and focused on proving the place mechanism generalizes to oil/FRY, not a complete serving recipe.
